name: Outside the Elevator
source:
You're trying to get to work, but the elevator stops. A man tries to help you out, but something about him seems off.

[From [url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/outside-the-elevator]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正试图去上班，但电梯停了下来。一个男人试图帮助你，但他身上似乎有些不对劲。

[来自[url=https://marrowed-yuu.itch.io/outside-the-elevator]Itch.io[/url]]
